summary: TruGolf Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a one-for-ten reverse stock split effective 12:01 a.m. Eastern on September 29, 2026, effected via a Nevada Certificate of Change under NRS 78.209 without stockholder approval because authorized and outstanding shares were proportionally reduced. Authorized common stock fell from 101,000,000 to 10,100,000 shares; every ten pre-split shares automatically combined into one, with cash paid in lieu of fractional shares and a new CUSIP 243733607. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor were disclosed; the split is a routine capital-structure action, not a special situation.
